citation.title: An FPGA-Based, Full-Digital Phase Comparator of a Multi-chord Interferometer for Real-Time Density Control in KSTAR
citation.authors: J.-W. Juhn, T. G. Lee, S. H. Hahn, K. C. Lee, Y. S. Kim, G. I. Kwon, S. J. Lee, H. Han, Y. H. Lee, Y. U. Nam

topic: FPGA digital phase comparator for a KSTAR five-chord two-color interferometer that feeds line-integrated electron density to the PCS for real-time density feedback.
own_question: Can a fully digital I-Q/CORDIC phase comparator replace analog comparators to provide higher-bandwidth, lower-noise real-time multi-chord line density for control?
actual_method_and_evidence: Paper text describes 160 MSPS digitization of 40 MHz IF signals, FPGA CORDIC phase computation, averaging to 625 kSPS, and HPC/RFM transfer to the PCS, where reference-chord drift is subtracted. Its evidence consists of a PSD comparison between two discharges, reported as roughly 100x lower noise below 30 kHz, and one discharge example of reference subtraction. No CES, ion temperature, nowcasting, or forecasting is involved. Latency is not quantified.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR has an existing real-time multi-chord interferometer path delivering line-integrated electron density to the PCS for density feedback.
claim_checks.qualification: This is an electron line-density diagnostic, not an ion or impurity temperature measurement. End-to-end latency is not reported. The demonstration rests on example discharges, not validated control performance.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Measures current line density from phase. It is not a prediction of a delayed report. Sampling is 625 kSPS, but arrival latency is unknown.
validation_if_relevant: Consists of noise PSD for two shots and one illustrative shot. There is no held-out statistical validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as evidence of CES or Ti real-time availability or of CES latency.
Do not imply that BES/ECEI or our inputs used this hardware.
Do not cite as validated closed-loop control performance or profile control achieved.
Do not generalize to all KSTAR real-time diagnostics.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most an optional single contextual citation showing that KSTAR already has some real-time electron-density diagnostics feeding the PCS. It does not support our ion-impurity temperature nowcasting claims. It can be omitted without loss.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
